app_info.description: Research property assessments and prepare draft comparisons in supported pilot areas. Create a free private veteran review PDF from a saved review you select, with unanswered questions shown. County records, your answers and any VA information you choose to share are identified separately. Missing building, identity, tax-year, taxable-value or filing evidence can limit the review. Drafts do not complete official forms, establish eligibility or authorize filing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Get retained county assessment observations and source provenance for a supported address or parcel ID. Missing facts stay unavailable; commercial source area is not finished living area. Any comparison is a draft with evidence holds and does not establish personal tax savings or filing readiness. For a property audit or a request to find tax-reduction routes, review opportunity_screen before concluding. A weak or held comparable-property analysis does not rule out independent relief, record corrections or billing research. Ask the next relevant unanswered targeted_questions item one at a time; use available_questions for relevant follow-ups. Accept none, not sure or skip, and do not repeat answered or skipped questions in this conversation unless the user changes the facts. After an answer, call recheck_property_opportunities for the same selected property and county with the accumulated explicit owner_answers and skipped_question_ids. Rechecks are stateless: resend still-applicable prior answers, preserve explicit false and empty arrays, and omit unknown or skipped fields instead of sending null or inventing a negative answer. Resend stable skipped_question_ids until the user supplies an answer or asks to revisit the question. Skips suppress prompts only and leave requirements unresolved. Do not transfer property-specific answers or skips to another property. When the user is done or skips the remaining questions, summarize supported research routes and missing evidence without treating unknowns as a denial. For a fact-only lookup, answer the requested fact and offer relevant screening without requiring an unrelated intake. Owner answers do not verify eligibility, savings, authority, payment or filing readiness. It does not change saved records.

When an order_id is known, read the same order after checkout or an uncertain failure before retrying. If starting checkout fails before an order_id is returned, retry start_tax_sandbox with the original idempotency_key; do not create a new key for the same attempt. get_tax_sandbox_order and complete_tax_sandbox_order take only order_id. Report test payment, draft generation, download availability and external delivery as separate observed states. Do not claim the draft is available until the order confirms its artifact is available; a payment or download URL alone is not proof. A sandbox receipt or simulated submission is not county filing, external email delivery or permission for live payments. It does not change saved records.
